name: Canopy
tagline: A code-editor extension that flags energy-wasteful patterns and translates the cost into everyday terms.
problem: Developers do not see the environmental cost of inefficient code.
solution: Analyses code for patterns like excessive polling or N+1 queries and expresses the energy as equivalents such as homes powered.
demo_moment: Team-described: open a file and see a wasteful query flagged.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Sustainability - Sponsored by SustainableIT” among 231 submissions.

lessons: Translate units into things people picture.
